baseline_identity: Current V59 Hook(all_tokens=True), freshly trained on each original benchmark native edit; not historical V22 SOURCE answer-predictor-only, and not V50 multi-support W0
selection: Original benchmark146 first ten in original order; all previously exposed development data, no independent-confirmation claim
training: Exactly original image/question/target per edit. No FIT, generalized query, locality, caption, V58-V60 candidate, ROI, teacher answer or auxiliary supervision used for training/model selection.
evaluation: Restore original full per-edit consumers before V22 protection-support removals; 219 consumers per arm and 183 unique Base inputs. Original additional FIT wording is evaluation-only REPHRASE_DIAGNOSTIC.

task_semantics.REPHRASE_DIAGNOSTIC: existing same-image wording variants, not official T2G

optimizer: Existing canonical two-group scalar RMS proposal, clip1, same update construction as V59
loss: Single original edit answer CE including original tokenization/EOS; no hinge or auxiliary loss
decode: Existing native greedy full free answer, max_new_tokens1024, EOS only
mask: A all unpadded positions; B input prefix positions only, including final prompt position; C actual multimodal-expanded visual-token positions only. Teacher forcing and cached/uncached generation use identical absolute-position boundaries.
cache: Only frozen layers strictly before layer21 cached for fixed teacher batches. Edited layer and all downstream layers recomputed every update. Generation recomputes prefix and downstream KV per request; no stale KV between parameter updates.
admission: CPU synthetic mask/KV/gradient/text-only invariance; real zero-TT complete generation parity, nonzero-mask teacher/prefill/KV logits parity at rtol1e-5 atol5e-4, finite nonzero CE gradients through each path, exact frozen-prefix-cache CE/gradient parity, A legacy all-token implementation parity; checkpoint save/load exact. No formal updates until all three arms pass first-source admission.
metrics: Blinded C/I/U/A full-answer grading; source success, T1G, T2G, rephrase, both locality tasks, full Base-to-method transitions and real Base-correct damage denominators (NA if zero). Source fact propagation only where reference-based applicability is established; exact source-answer echo on an incorrect output reported as conservative operational measure, not all answer-string differences as negatives. Residual norms, source CE, costs, runtime and parameter counts reported.
decision: Development signal only if candidate preserves all A-correct T0 edits, has no aggregate T1G/T2G correctness loss, no additional Base-correct locality loss and at least one strict generalization or qualified erroneous-echo improvement versus A. Report B versus C and per-edit tradeoffs regardless; no post-result seed/layer/mask/loss search. If C only suppresses editing, do not call it a gain; if B accounts for gain do not claim visual specificity. No signal closes hypothesis. Positive signal requires separate confirmation admission, not immediate promotion.
lifecycle: Keep 30 small delta states through full evaluation, save/load verification and scoring/next-decision consumers; then retire exact list, no model downloads
monitor: Do not restore V60 or its deleted monitor; this finite new experiment is separate and retains original window deadline
prior_negatives: V59 failed and V60 data-insufficient states remain immutable
